title: Daande Noddunde Peewal
intro: E nder leydi Madiyan ɓooyndi, ɗo njulaagu ina yaaji, ɗo karallaagal yahrata e nder jeereendeeji mawɗi, annabi Alla ummiima e nder yimɓe majjuɓe e laawol nuunɗal. Oo maccuɗo Alla neldaama e njillu diineyankeewu jarriborɗo iimanaagal renndo fof. E nder jarribooji muñal e muñal, ooɗoo ruuhu dariima e yettinde jeertinaango ngo ina rewna e nder daartol. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sirlu oo nulaaɗo tiiɗɗo?
clues: Mi suɓaama e Alla ngam ardude e leñol yejjitnoongol piɓle nuunɗal e nuunɗal e nder gollondiral mum.
Mi yettinii nulal noddaango renndo am nde rewata hay gooto so wonaa Alla e haalde goonga e kala ko woni.
Mi jeertinii teeŋti noon e bonanndeeji baɗeteeɗi e ñaamde jawdi e nder laabi ɗi ngonaa sariya, mi teeŋtinii nafoore teddeendi e peeje nuunɗuɗe.
Leñol am jaabtii jeertinaango am e jaleeɗe, ina hulɓina mi riiwtude mi e leydi maɓɓe so mi jokkii konngol am.
Mi heddii e tiiɗnaare e golle am hay so tawii ko ɓe gaññeeje, miɗo anndina njoɓdi am ko e Alla tan woni.
Yimɓe am nanngaama e jukkungo bonngo nde mi hisnaa e yurmeende Joomiraawo am, no kuugal am timmirta nii.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Haɓde e leñol saliiɓe goonga, hulɓiniiɓe jukkungo ngam yettinde nulal Alla
Seedaade ilam mawɗam kalkunoojam heeferɓe leñol
Jaɓde wahyu nde njahata e nder falnde of笃
Ñaawoore iimanaagal nde laamɗo tooñoowo etinooma muumtude noddaango ngootaagu
Leñol商ƴamoowo toɓo e nder yooro mawngo caggal duuɓi ɗowtanagol
trial.answer: Haɓde e leñol saliiɓe goonga, hulɓiniiɓe jukkungo ngam yettinde nulal Alla

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Leydi Madiyan, to yimɓe am mbaɗata filu mum en e filu mum en
Deki laana mawka danndunooka gooŋɗinɓe e ilam bonɗam
Ngaska e nder tulde kaaƴe ɗo sukaaɓe njeeɗiɗo ɗaɓɓi daɗndude e tooñanngeeji
Wuro ceniingo Urusaliima ɗo njahratnoo-mi e yahdu jamma
Palas to Seba ɗo laamu mawngu feewni ngam seedaade maande Alla
location.answer: Leydi Madiyan, to yimɓe am mbaɗata filu mum en e filu mum en

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Yimɓe am nanngaama e jukkungo hulɓiniingo nde ngonmi e hisde, sabu mi hebbinii fodde am e Alla
Heefeero en mbaɗtaama wonti apes no ɓe mbonniri keeri Alla ceniiɗi ɗii
Añɓe am njaɓɓii goonɗinal caggal nde ceedtii waylo-waylo kaawis
Leydi ndii barkinii e toɓo keewngo e wellitaare caggal nde yimɓe ɓee tuubi
Mi martiri ɗum ko leñol am sabu mi saliima woppude golle am
outcome.answer: Yimɓe am nanngaama e jukkungo hulɓiniingo nde ngonmi e hisde, sabu mi hebbinii fodde am e Alla

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verse: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh? (26:177)
